scripts.dev: bun run docker:up && trap 'bun run docker:stop' EXIT && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --filter=!@cap/chrome-extension --env-mode=loose --ui tui
scripts.dev:extension: bun run docker:up && trap 'bun run docker:stop' EXIT && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --filter=@cap/web --filter=@cap/chrome-extension --env-mode=loose --ui tui
scripts.dev:manual: bun run docker:up && trap 'bun run docker:stop' EXIT && dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --filter=!@cap/chrome-extension --no-cache --concurrency 1
scripts.dev:mobile: bun run docker:up && trap 'bun run docker:stop' EXIT && CAP_MOBILE_DISABLE_ASSOCIATED_DOMAINS=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_CAP_WEB_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_CAP_WEB_URL:-http://localhost:3000} dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --filter=@cap/web --filter=@cap/mobile --env-mode=loose --ui tui
scripts.dev:mobile:physical: bun run docker:up && trap 'bun run docker:stop' EXIT && CAP_MOBILE_DEVICE=physical CAP_MOBILE_DISABLE_ASSOCIATED_DOMAINS=1 dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --filter=@cap/web --filter=@cap/mobile --env-mode=loose --ui tui
scripts.tauri:build: dotenv -e .env -- bun run --cwd apps/desktop build:tauri --config src-tauri/tauri.prod.conf.json --verbose
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web next typegen && bun run tsc -b
scripts.test:discover: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- discover
scripts.test:matrix: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- matrix
scripts.test:matrix:quick: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- matrix --quick
scripts.test:matrix:exhaustive: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- matrix --exhaustive
scripts.test:synthetic: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- synthetic
scripts.test:benchmark: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- benchmark
scripts.test:suite:recording: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- suite recording
scripts.test:suite:encoding: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- suite encoding
scripts.test:suite:playback: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- suite playback
scripts.test:suite:sync: bun run with-env cargo run -p cap-test -- suite sync
scripts.clean: find . -name node_modules -o -name .next -o -name .output -o -name .turbo -o -name dist -type d -prune | xargs rm -rf
